title: Deliver Copper Ore to Slardworth Factory
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Copper Ore** delivered to **Slardworth Factory** (industry id 10, near tile 23,40).

A likely supplier is **Sundhattan Ridge Copper Ore Mine** (industry id 1, near tile 43,37); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **6,000 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
